KEY. SRS=FBI Summary Return-A (monthly Return A rolled to a year; it is the only FBI-side lane that can record a literal ZERO months reported). NIB=FBI NIBRS rolled to Part-I equivalents (a NIBRS row exists only if the agency's batch header reports >=1 month). Year lines: 'YY: LANE total/months_reported/tier' -- 12mo=full year, 0mo=SRS carries the agency but records zero months submitted, 'none'=no row in any lane, NoF7=fewer than 7 offense rows in that lane-year. CW=footprint ('statewide_overlap_layer'=mass smeared over the whole state; 'state_nonmunicipal_remainder'=the unincorporated remainder; 'municipal:place:XXXXXXX'=one Census place). KNOWN INGESTION ARTIFACTS, stated explicitly so you do not have to infer them:

(2) The CIUS published table carries NO months-reported column. The pipeline assigns months_reported=12, quality tier 'high' and weight 1.0 to every CIUS row by assumption, and CIUS outranks both FBI submission lanes in the source-preference ladder.
